name: holdout_logistics
description: Holdout: a carrier is supporting in one goal and primary in another.
resource_constraints_text: Deploy on GCP Linux VMs in Seoul using Docker with a monthly budget of 500 USD. A single zone is acceptable. Daily label creation peaks occur at 18:00.

classified.text: Warehouse Operators create a shipment from a packed customer order.
The system requests available delivery services and prices from the external Carrier.
Warehouse Operators select a delivery service and the system requests a shipping label from the Carrier.
Warehouse Operators download and print the generated shipping label.
The Carrier submits pickup, transit, delivery, and exception events for a shipment.
Customers view the latest shipment status and tracking history.
Support Agents request cancellation of a shipment that has not been picked up, and the system sends the request to the Carrier.
Shipment and tracking records shall survive container and VM restarts.
Duplicate carrier event identifiers shall be processed at most once.
Carrier calls shall time out within five seconds and transient failures shall be retried.
The service shall process peaks of 100 label requests per second.
Carrier credentials shall be injected at runtime.
The application shall run in Docker containers on Linux VMs and emit structured logs.
